It adds three bullets inside the user:start markers. None touches cc's build-and-test bullet, so they apply on top of C1 and C4. The bullets: No Python (ST0001 AC-00.1), describing tools/nopython in cc's words, beside the people-leak bullet; The docs, pointing at README.md (compiled in: help --details prints it verbatim, and a bats test needs its title line), usage-rules.md, CHANGELOG.md (2.0.0's divergences), intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE.md and the two design records; and The goldens are frozen (tests/golden/README.md). It lands after C5 with the rest. One point for C4: its bullet keeps the hand list '(fmt, clippy, autotests, targetdir, critic)', and C4 adds nopython to it. By your README ruling, 'every read-only gate; bin/devbin help check names them' would not drift. That line is cc's, so it is for you and cc. (3) FYI: hv asked why the estate page shows cc's slots as orphaned. The cause is intentd's environment. It runs under launchd (parent pid 1, up since 21:48 yesterday) without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so it looks for Claude Code's session files under ~/.claude/sessions, which does not exist, finds no session, and draws every granted or running hold as orphaned under its raw session id. intent estate status reproduces it with the variable unset: sessions 0, and AWFZSH and YJW4P5 orphaned under f3516df3. The CLI, with the variable set, is right, and the slots themselves are fine. I have told hv. The fix is in hv's environment, or an Intent issue, outside pplr's scope.
